en: A color illustration of a large early‑20th‑century passenger steamship at sea, with a black hull, white superstructure, and a single funnel painted red with a white band. Smaller sailing craft are in the foreground on choppy blue water, and other steamers appear faintly in the distance under a cloudy sky. The scene is rendered in a painterly style, typical of vintage maritime postcards. There are faint signatures or captions at the lower corners but they are not fully legible.
